tab.creator: Creator
d.hitmarkers: Crosshair mark when you hit a target.
d.beam: Beam or lightning where you kill.
d.burst: Particle burst on the kill spot.
d.hitsnd: Click to pick and hear a sound.
d.killsnd: Click to pick and hear a sound.
d.volume: Volume of hit and kill sounds.
d.guisnd: Sounds for clicks and moving the menu.
d.mask: Stars instead of the password in /login.
d.green: Green sky for cutting out in editing.
d.playsong: Starts or stops the chosen song.
d.lyrics: Shows the song text above the hotbar.
d.hudedit: Drag the widgets with the mouse.
d.showmarks: Circle, line and coordinates in the world.
d.showdist: Metres or kilometres on the mark.
d.markhere: Adds a mark where you stand (key B).
i.files: Drop .ogg onto the game window while the menu is open.
i.macrohint: Command, then +, then a key. Right-click a macro: run on join.
i.marks: Key B adds or removes a mark here.
i.songfiles: Pick the song first, then drop its .lrc for subtitles.
d.freelook: Hold a key and turn the camera around you.
d.freelookkey: Click, then press the key you want.
d.markcolor: Colour of all marks (AUTO = each its own).
d.markfx: Pulse, glow and orbiting sparks on marks.
d.profile: Click to switch: Default, PvP, Creator, Cinema, Beauty, yours.
d.profexport: Copies your settings to the clipboard to share.
d.clipkey: Hides the whole HUD like F1 in one press.
d.zoom: Hold a key to zoom in on distant things.
d.zoomkey: Click, then press the key you want.
d.zoomfactor: How much the view is magnified.
d.armorwarn: Plays when a piece drops under 15 percent.
d.hudopacity: How see-through the widget background is.
d.hudsnap: Widgets stick to a 4 pixel grid.
i.profiles: Type a name below and press the button to save your setup.
d.trail: Coloured trail behind arrows and pearls.
d.jumpring: Wave ring when you jump or land.
d.vignette: Soft glow or dark edges around the screen.
d.tint: Light tint over the whole picture.
d.weather: Snow, rain or petals only for you.
d.addhit: Click, then drop an .ogg onto the game window.
d.addkill: Click, then drop an .ogg onto the game window.
d.addsong: Click, then drop an .ogg (and a .lrc) here.
d.hitmax: Longer sounds are cut to this many seconds.
d.killmax: Longer sounds are cut to this many seconds.
d.lyricsscale: How big the song text is on screen.
d.info: Logo, client name, FPS, ping and more.
d.wmfps: Shows frames per second in the bar.
d.wmcoords: Shows your XYZ in the bar.
d.wmtime: Shows the real time in the bar.
d.cps: Left and right clicks per second.
d.cooldown: Pearl, chorus, shield and apple timers.
d.target: Name, health and armor of who you hit.
d.reloadpacks: Reloads resource packs in one click.
d.profilekey: Press to switch to the next profile.
m.nodrop: Now drop the file onto the game window...
d.opensounds: Put .ogg (Vorbis) files here, or drop them on the menu.
d.opensongs: Put song.ogg and song.lrc here, or drop them on the menu.
i.dropsounds: Files appear in the list at once. Format: OGG Vorbis.
i.dropsongs: Drop song.ogg here, then its .lrc for subtitles.
d.swordskin: Your swords look like Metka (only you see it).
d.swordtarget: Which sword type gets the skin.
d.hat: Chinese straw hat on your head (third person).
d.hatsize: Make the hat bigger or smaller.
d.headring: Glowing ring like a halo (third person).
d.ringsize: Size of the ring above your head.
d.wings: Light wings on your back (third person).
d.god: Ring, wings and glow in one click.
d.customlobby: Replaces the title screen with the Fluti lobby.
d.lyricsmode: WORLD floats words around you, SCREEN is a caption.
d.lyricsdist: How far from you the words float.
d.lyricsscatter: How randomly the words are spread.
